title: Nano gold tube composite film coated with graphene oxide and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a nano gold tube composite film coated with graphene oxide and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of nano composite materials. The nano gold tube composite film is composed of a hollow tubular nano gold film layer and a graphene oxide layer, the thickness of the hollow tubular nano gold film layer is 60-150 nm, and the thickness of the graphene oxide layer is 0.6-12 nm. Compared with other metal particles, gold nanoparticles provided by the invention have higher detection sensitivity, thus the obtained Raman enhancement effect is better, the oxidationof the gold nanoparticles can be prevented by using the graphene oxide as a protective layer, the stability of a substrate is improved, and the defect that the gold nanoparticles are used as the Raman enhancement substrate alone is overcome.
